source_policy: Primary public sources only. Scenario inputs are user-supplied fictional planning data, not observed company measurements.

sources.title: Azure OpenAI reasoning models
supports: The GPT-6 feature table lists gpt-6-luna version 2026-09-22, alongside newer GPT-6.1 models.
GPT-6 models are listed with structured outputs, the Responses API and reasoning effort. The table marks temperature supported for Luna, but the unsupported-parameters section contradicts this.
Responses uses max_output_tokens; input and output limits share the context budget.
Current feature table lists Luna context 1,050,000 tokens, maximum input 922,000 and maximum output 128,000; these are documented capacities, not account verification.
limits: Documentation verifies supported interfaces, not account entitlement, regional quota, measured quality or latency.
Proposed limits and sampling settings require endpoint validation.
Explicit Luna temperature compatibility remains unresolved: the feature table and unsupported-parameters section disagree. Omit temperature pending endpoint validation.

sources.title: GPT-6 Luna model
supports: GPT-6 Luna is positioned for focused high-volume tasks and supports low reasoning effort.
Published direct OpenAI Standard rates are USD 0.10 per million uncached input tokens and USD 0.50 per million output tokens.
Regional processing, larger contexts and service modes can change rates.
limits: These are direct OpenAI rates, not an Azure quote. Azure pricing page fetch timed out.
Model marketing is not evidence of suitability for industrial safety or multilingual quality.

sources.title: RAG and generative AI in Azure AI Search
supports: RAG retrieves external grounding content before generation.
Microsoft describes classic RAG as suitable when generally available features, simplicity, speed and fine control are priorities.
Chunking and vectorization are indexing steps; hybrid queries and optional semantic ranking are query options.
limits: RAG does not guarantee correctness or citation faithfulness.
Agentic retrieval exists; choosing classic RAG here is a design judgment for a small, tightly controlled pilot.

sources.title: Hybrid search overview
supports: Hybrid search runs keyword and vector queries in parallel and combines results using reciprocal rank fusion.
Keyword search can provide precision for product codes and specialist terms while vector search finds conceptual similarity.
limits: No application-specific relevance gain or accuracy percentage is established.
Part validity still needs deterministic lookup against the authoritative catalogue.

sources.title: Security filters for trimming results in Azure AI Search
supports: A security filter pattern stores principal identifiers and filters results using search.in.
The pattern applies when built-in document ACL support is unavailable.
limits: String filtering is an application-enforced pattern, not automatic identity authorization.
Server-side construction, deny-by-default behavior, tenant boundaries and leakage tests remain implementation requirements.

sources.title: Data, privacy, and security for Models sold by Azure in Microsoft Foundry
supports: Prompts, completions, embeddings and training data are not available to OpenAI or other customers and are not used to train foundation models without permission or instruction.
Abuse monitoring can include storage and authorized Microsoft human review; modified monitoring requires approval.
Global processing can occur in any supported geography; DataZone processing stays within its specified zone.
limits: Do not claim zero retention or unconditional single-region processing.
Privacy configuration and contractual review are deployment prerequisites, not completed certifications.

sources.title: Maintenance Copilot documentation
supports: Asset Essentials Enterprise Maintenance Copilot uses linked asset manuals and maintenance records for in-context work-order support.
The documented feature is available on web and mobile; mobile requires online mode.
Siemens says data quality affects output usefulness.
limits: This is vendor documentation, not independent comparative testing.
It establishes an adjacent competitor; it does not prove the proposed product is uniquely capable or faster.

sources.title: Genix APM Copilot
supports: ABB offers conversational access to operational information within its Genix APM infrastructure.
limits: Claims about speed and downtime on this vendor page are not transferred into the proposal as measured benefits.
No head-to-head evaluation or pricing comparison was conducted.

sources.title: Industrial robot systems and industrial robot system safety
sources.publisher: US Occupational Safety and Health Administration
supports: OSHA identifies hazards across robot operation, programming and maintenance and discusses risk assessment, safeguarding and hazardous-energy control.
limits: The manual is technical guidance for inspection and hazard understanding, not certification of a chatbot.
Local obligations and current applicable standards require qualified safety/legal review.

sources.title: Understand embeddings in Azure OpenAI
supports: Embeddings represent text as vectors for similarity search and can support Azure AI Search retrieval.
limits: The page is marked Foundry classic. Confirm current deployment support and model version before provisioning.
Embedding retrieval does not validate exact part identifiers or language quality.
